title: Kiss of Death
setup: The black king is cornered on h8, your king stands guard on f6, and your queen has the g-file.
hint: The queen can afford to stand right beside the king — your own king watches the landing square.
explanation:
## The Idea

This is the supported queen kiss: the queen lands right beside the enemy king, and your own king makes it untouchable.

{{Qg7#}} gives check. The king on f6 guards g7, so the king on h8 cannot take the queen, and g8 and h7 are both covered by the queen. A check from the next square cannot be blocked.

A queen next to the enemy king is mate whenever something guards it and the king has no other square.
